title: Turning log matches into records
description: You can follow named captures into counts and selected messages.

steps.description: LOG contains six records. You name the date, time, level and msg captures in one compiled pattern.
Each match contributes a dictionary through groupdict. For the first match, you print each field and its start and end offsets.

steps.question: How many records will Counter report for each supplied level?
steps.answer: It reports two WARN, two INFO and two ERROR records.

steps.description: You see the three counts followed by only the ERROR messages. Those messages share the disk-full text and appear at 08:12:03 and 08:15:59.
